governance_note: Document what is included, excluded, and outside the representational scope of the matrix.
Record substantive meaning of rows and columns before interpreting any computation.
Clarify what entries and zeros mean, including missingness and thresholding rules.
Document raw units, standardization, normalization, transformations, and comparability assumptions.
Review categorical encoding, aggregation, discretization, and resolution choices.
State whether interpretation occurs in original variables, standardized coordinates, PCA components, eigenmodes, or embeddings.
Compare conclusions across alternative reasonable representations where conclusions matter.
Communicate what the representation can support and what it cannot justify.
